title: VerificationOps

contracts.description: For kind 'inline': the contract documents — Janus contracts or v1–v4 pacts (any supported spec version).

VerificationTarget.title: VerificationTarget
VerificationTarget.description: The provider under test: transport bindings as open descriptor documents, plus open options (state-change/hook config is design 2.7's).

interaction.title: ExplainSubject
interaction.description: What to compile: an interaction specification or one interaction from a contract document.

contract.description: For kind 'contract-interaction': the contract document (a Janus contract or a v1–v4 pact).

plan.description: The structured plan document, when requested via options.
